sql: SELECT j.jobid, j.jobname, j.schedule, j.active, substring(j.command from 'functions/v1/([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)') AS fn, CASE WHEN j.command ILIKE '%functions/v1/%' THEN NULL ELSE left(regexp_replace(regexp_replace(j.command, 'eyJ[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+', '<jwt>', 'g'), '\s+', ' ', 'g'), 250) END AS cmd, (SELECT max(d.start_time) FROM cron.job_run_details d WHERE d.jobid = j.jobid) AS last_run, (SELECT count(*) FROM cron.job_run_details d WHERE d.jobid = j.jobid AND d.start_time > now() - interval '7 days') AS runs_7d, (SELECT count(*) FROM cron.job_run_details d WHERE d.jobid = j.jobid AND d.start_time > now() - interval '7 days' AND d.status <> 'succeeded') AS fails_7d FROM cron.job j ORDER BY j.jobname
